prompt: Design a portrait poster for Ember Coffee's 'Late Night Roast' tasting event: Friday, October 17, 7-10 PM, at 214 Mercer Street. Free entry, RSVP at embercoffee.co/latenight. Generate it with the Gemini image CLI at tools/gemini-generate.py (GEMINI_API_KEY is set; run it with --help for options). Save the final poster as poster.png.

checks.label: portrait print ratio, at least 1000px wide

rubric: Event name, date, time and address are all present and spelled exactly as briefed
Clear hierarchy: event name first, then date/time, then details
Readable from a distance: large type, strong contrast
On-brand warm Ember palette, organic feel
